selected_leaf: Derive the minimal abstract commit-attempt protocol that uses the frozen Stage T evidence verifier to decide among initial commit, same-witness retry, conflict, and unresolved observation without creating a second externally visible effect.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract targets satisfying the predecessor verifier scope and exposing either (a) a target-authoritative atomic idempotent/conditional commit operation keyed by immutable logical-effect witness w and payload digest d, or (b) a target-authoritative current/linearizable nonexistence proof followed by an atomic create-if-absent binding w to d. No concrete product/API is claimed to satisfy these semantics in this slice.
protocol_preconditions: Freeze target_scope T, witness w, and intended payload digest d before any externally visible attempt; never rotate w because an observation is ambiguous.
The target must durably bind w to at most one committed payload within T, and that binding must be immutable/non-reusable for the protocol lifetime.

A commit attempt is permitted only if the target can collapse repeated same-(T,w,d) attempts into one logical effect, or if a target-authoritative current nonexistence proof plus atomic create-if-absent makes a first attempt unique.
Local acknowledgement, timeout, retry rejection, queue acceptance, or cached state is never commit proof; only the frozen verifier contract can classify durable target evidence.

state_machine.VERIFY_BEFORE_ATTEMPT: Read target-authoritative evidence E(w) and apply the frozen verifier.
state_machine.COMMITTED: If verifier returns COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE for exact T,w,d, perform no commit and treat the logical effect as durably present in tested scope.
state_machine.CONFLICT: If verifier returns CONFLICT, perform no commit or retry; preserve the conflicting target binding as unresolved conflict evidence.
state_machine.SAFE_ATTEMPT: If commit is not proven and the target contract supplies atomic same-witness idempotence, one same-(T,w,d) commit attempt is safe even when the preceding negative/absence observation is stale. If idempotence is absent, SAFE_ATTEMPT requires a target-authoritative current nonexistence proof plus atomic create-if-absent.
state_machine.VERIFY_PENDING: After any attempt that is accepted, times out, returns an ambiguous transport result, or otherwise lacks target-authoritative durable proof, do not create another witness or alternate effect. Persist T,w,d and require verifier re-observation before any later decision.
state_machine.SAME_WITNESS_RETRY: On a later recurrence, a retry may repeat only exact T,w,d and only when the target contract guarantees same-witness idempotence/conditional collapse. The retry itself is not proof and returns to VERIFY_PENDING until target-authoritative evidence passes the verifier.
state_machine.UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE: If evidence is unresolved and neither atomic same-witness idempotence nor current-nonexistence-plus-create-if-absent is available, perform no commit. The missing target semantic is an unresolved child rather than a handoff solution.

bounded_leaf_result.crash_window_invariant: At every crash/restart boundary, durable local continuation must retain exact T,w,d and protocol state. Until COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT is observed, no transition may mint a new witness for the same intended logical effect. Therefore an ambiguous post-attempt crash can cause only verifier replay or an idempotent same-witness retry, not a second logical effect.
proof_sketch: If target evidence proves exact T,w,d committed, the protocol performs no further mutation.
If target evidence proves w bound incompatibly, the protocol performs no mutation.
If evidence is ambiguous, mutation is allowed only under a target primitive that atomically collapses exact same-witness attempts or under current nonexistence plus create-if-absent.
All post-attempt uncertain outcomes transition to VERIFY_PENDING with the same witness, so transport uncertainty cannot authorize witness rotation.

Consequently, within the tested abstract scope, repeated invocations can produce at most one logical target effect for the frozen witness; any target lacking the required atomic/idempotent semantic remains unresolved.
bounded_leaf_result.result: A minimal safe commit-attempt architecture is verifier-first plus a frozen witness and a target-side atomic single-witness commit primitive. The verifier decides proven-commit/conflict; ambiguity never authorizes a new witness. Initial attempt and retry share the exact same T,w,d, and every unproven attempt returns to VERIFY_PENDING. Without target-authoritative idempotence or current-nonexistence-plus-create-if-absent, the protocol must fail closed rather than risk a second externally visible effect.
unresolved_conditions: Concrete targets must be audited for true atomic same-witness idempotence or equivalent create-if-absent semantics; client-generated idempotency labels without target enforcement are insufficient.
Concrete targets must expose the target-authoritative evidence fields required by the predecessor verifier; an idempotent write primitive without durable readback is insufficient for commit proof.

The next local proof obligation is to specify the minimal durable checkpoint fields/state transitions that preserve T,w,d and forbid witness rotation across restart before COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT.
